android_app_open: not enabled; no confirmed operating unit supplied

policy.entry: cold start or paused→resumed only; inactive→resumed does not create an opportunity
policy.cooldown: 10 minutes shared with workout interstitial, persisted only on showed callback using the existing preferences field
policy.load_opportunity: 3 seconds of loading cover; late load cached for next entry
policy.presentation_check: cover remains during consent recheck/presentation until showed, terminal callback or 30-second unconfirmed watchdog

recovery: Existing consent/SDK initialization and canRequestAds recheck reused; no policy bypass
Common loader handles create/load Future exceptions, 15-second timeout, backoff and generation-based late callback rejection
App-open and interstitial share one fullscreen lock and presentation state machine
Route, foreground and consent rechecked immediately before show
Cache is consumed once; duplicate callback cannot duplicate cooldown or dispose
Ad opportunity, decision, skip reason, load, actual showed/impression and disposal tracked in Analytics

validation.mode: Fake SDK, official iOS test units for app-open scenarios

limits: No Fill, network, actual UMP permission, AdMob account and mediation behavior are not code-controlled fill guarantees

If native SDK never emits any terminal callback, the 30-second watchdog releases the loading cover but retains uncertain fullscreen ownership to prevent overlapping a late native ad. A later terminal callback recovers; without one, process restart is needed. This residual SDK-boundary risk is not reported as fixed.
Real iOS initial-install/upgrade consent, cold/warm entry, background during load, ad click/return, actual impression/dismiss and mediation adapters require device validation.
No full regression/build/production inventory claim; one scoped verification command only.
